description: Réutilisations de données Open Data SNCF is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Ce jeu de données répertorie les réutilisations que nous avons pu identifier utilisant des données SNCF. Il sera mis à jour régulièrement. Si vous avez d'autres réutilisations à nous indiquer, n'hésitez pas à nous les soumettre via l'adresse open-data@sncf.fr. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Informations Institutionnelles. Its keywords are Réutilisations. The portal shows 2023-09-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
